opening.argument: The video explains ordinary ways to sell unwanted gift cards through named resale sites and Coinstar Exchange. It describes entering information to receive an offer, then accepting it and mailing the card to receive a check. For viewers seeking instant cash, it identifies Coinstar Exchange machines while warning that this option will likely pay less than a website. The screens reinforce those qualifications: one displays a mail offer, and another notes that gift-card acceptance varies by kiosk and region. These concrete transaction steps and limits support an instructional account of a resale service, not evidence of deception.

citations.quote: Sites like Cardpull.com, GiftCardZen.com and Raise.com will let you sell your unwanted gift cards in exchange for up to 92% of the value.
If you accept the offer, the company typically gives you a free shipping label to send your card in and will then mail you a check.
It will likely be less than what you would get going through a website
